selection: Stage 5 selected_parameters.json is used without retuning
leakage: Replace four historical revenue neighbors with first four available calendar neighbors in order t-1,t+1,t-2,t+2,t-3,t+3,t-4,t+4. Exclude current revenue. Recompute mean2/mean4/median/std/MAD/min/max/zero share/fill share and all revenue deviations from that window. lag_1..lag_4 reflect this order. Keep prior counts and prior last-positive information unchanged.
scale_policy: Use the same causal stage4 training-only scale floor for both arms to isolate neighbor-information effect
boundary_policy: At week35 no future exists; use prior four neighbors. Earlier fit rows still use hindsight in control arm, which may extend into score weeks. Models/imputers are fit only on past row keys in both arms.
purpose: Controlled retrospective information-contamination experiment; causal arm is primary scientific result. No claim of isolated single-feature causality or universal inflation.
